objective: The health cache revalidates the document content before trusting a cached store, so a same-size rewrite that restores the timestamp is noticed.
decision_supported: Does an unchanged (mtime_ns, size) prove the bytes are unchanged? No: a same-size in-place rewrite defeats it, so the signature is a hint rather than proof.
acceptance: A same-size rewrite with a restored mtime is re-read.
An untouched document is not re-ingested.
The digest is recorded alongside the stat signature.
stop_conditions: The change would need a control-path change.
risks_and_fallbacks: Hashing on every refresh costs a read; the document is bounded and small, and correctness wins here.
